items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Finally, finally I got in with Lionel Hampton, and this was long before he was known. And he had a band at the Culver City, and in that band I remember Hershel Evans.

ctx.x: to a, to a, California. He lived in Los Angeles. But I had, hadn't been to California at that, at that time, you know.

Ok. Let's see. Are there any other things you'd like to say as far as being in California? You eventually -- 1935 was a big year for you. Something very important happened then. You were a young man about 22-23 years old, and a gentleman by the name of Lionel Hampton . . .
Oh yes, yes, yes. I'm gonna start from the time I graduated at Sherman in 1933.
